title: Kit Virtual File System UI
description: Add unified FileSystemNode interface with computed parent/children/path across GraphQL golden schema, Rust store, and semio/js. Wire folder membership storage and createFolder/moveToFolder via existing kit operation mechanism.
summary: Scoped virtual file systems per app: VirtualFileSystemScope (appId + surfaceId), virtualFileSystemSurfaceId/registerAppVirtualFileSystem/registerAppVirtualFileSystem, per-app selection and lazy children stores, navigateUri on rows. Demo registers two apps with independent trees. SketchpadShellController extends VirtualFileSystemController; home/kit/design apps each use SketchpadAppVirtualFileSystem surfaces. Renderer passes appId on VFS commands. Platform core (11), renderer (19), ui (76) tests pass.
